answer: vihap.parse delegates to the default HierarchicalAddressParser.parse, whose _parse_address_fused preprocesses text, resolves the admin hierarchy right-to-left with MacroAdminResolver, decomposes street components with MicroStreetParser, then _assemble_parsed_address constructs the ParsedAddress. Read vihap/__init__.py first for the public facade, then vihap/parsers/hierarchical_parser.py, vihap/parsers/macro_resolver.py, vihap/parsers/street_parser.py, vihap/parsers/pipeline.py, and vihap/models.py (with vihap/formatters/standard_formatter.py for formatted_standard).
